categories: 数据分析与大语言模型推理
name: spiceai/spiceai
summary: 据发布者介绍，Spice 是一款用 Rust 编写的引擎，可为业务数据库增加实时分析能力，并为使用这些数据的应用和智能体提供 SQL 查询、搜索和大语言模型推理。
The publisher describes Spice as a Rust engine that adds real-time analytics to an operational database and provides SQL queries, search, and LLM inference for apps and agents that use that data.
